project.name: agent-store-postgres
project.description: RING 2 — a pgvector-backed Retriever companion. Implements the ring-1 Retriever/ContextBudget seam over a PostgreSQL + pgvector table, returning qualitative grounding Evidence (never figures; ADR-0001/0008). Compiles against java.sql only — the JDBC driver is the consuming application's runtime concern — so its weight never reaches ring-1. The embedding seam (EmbeddingModel) lives here, not in ring-1: vector retrieval needs an embedder the dependency-free core deliberately lacks (a 1.0 reshape candidate). First shaped by the CxO consumer (R1.4). See docs/adr/adr-0013-postgres-pgvector-store.md.
